summary: Student Assistant v2: full backend + frontend regression PASSED. Backend 25/25 (16 v1 in backend_test.py + 9 new v2 in test_v2_features.py) including LLM-driven capture, auto-classify import with real JPEG, entity-based relationship linking (Assignment 2 Sociology follow-up correctly UPDATED not duplicated), overdue nudges ('Overdue —' / 'You promised to'), review shape with detected/suggestion/confidence_label, /api/courses + /api/courses/{name}, and approve/ignore/delete review actions. Frontend 5-tab nav (Today/Memory/center Capture FAB/Courses/Settings) verified; the v1 FAB routing bug is FIXED (FAB now navigates to /quick-capture cleanly). AI prompt bar, KPI stats, AI Inbox summary card, 'What needs attention' with Overdue nudge, and Recent memory all render on Home. Quick-capture: text capture works end-to-end (LLM committed a Calendar item), Photo/File attach buttons present. AI Inbox shows confidence badges + Approve/Edit/Ignore/Delete; approve commits and empties inbox. Memory tab: search box, type filter chips, course filter chips (All courses + CS101) render; jump-to-source arrows on note/course items. Courses tab lists CS101 with counts; tapping opens /course/CS101 workspace with Schedule, Assignments & tasks, Study notes, Memory sections.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings persist: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking on web preview, but should be migrated for RN new architecture. Likely origin: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow token) and (tabs)/_layout.tsx pointerEvents='box-none'.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Migrate 'shadow*' style props in src/theme.ts to boxShadow, and move pointerEvents='box-none' on (tabs)/_layout.tsx CaptureButton into style.pointerEvents.

(Optional) Consider removing the placeholder /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/capture.tsx (or converting its Tabs.Screen to href:null) since it is only used as a tab-bar slot for the FAB and its <Redirect> is never triggered now that routing goes to /quick-capture.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses @app.on_event('shutdown') (Starlette deprecation). Prefer FastAPI lifespan.
server.py file is ~520 lines - within limits, but consider splitting into routers (capture/tasks/events/courses/notes/review) if it grows further.
conftest.py now reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env; no hardcoded URL remaining.
